<section id="A1" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix A </span>The training of CoRAG</h2>

<div id="A1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The training of CoRAG has been summarized as Algorithm <a href="#alg1" title="Algorithm 1 ‣ Appendix A The training of CoRAG ‣ Rethinking Retrieval-Augmented Generation as a Cooperative Decision-Making Problem" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">1</span></a>.</p>
</div>
<figure id="alg1" class="ltx_float ltx_float_algorithm ltx_framed ltx_framed_top">
<figcaption class="ltx_caption"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_float"><span id="alg1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Algorithm 1</span> </span> Training of CoRAG</figcaption>
<div id="alg1.4" class="ltx_listing ltx_framed ltx_framed_topbottom ltx_listing">
<div id="alg1.l1" class="ltx_listingline">
            <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline">1:</span>
            
            
           <span id="alg1.l1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">for</span>  <math id="alg1.l1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t=1</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="alg1.l1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>T</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T</annotation></semantics></math> <span id="alg1.l1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">do</span>



</div>
<div id="alg1.l2" class="ltx_listingline">
            <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline">2:</span>
            
            
            <span id="alg1.l2.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">for</span>  query <math id="alg1.l2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q\in Q" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>Q</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q\in Q</annotation></semantics></math> <span id="alg1.l2.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">do</span>



</div>
<div id="alg1.l3" class="ltx_listingline">
            <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline">3:</span>
            
            
             Compute score <math id="alg1.l3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s_{i}=\mathcal{S}_{\theta}(q,d_{i})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>s</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒮</mi><mi>θ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>q</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>d</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s_{i}=\mathcal{S}_{\theta}(q,d_{i})</annotation></semantics></math>;

</div>
<div id="alg1.l4" class="ltx_listingline">
            <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline">4:</span>
            
            
             Select top-K documents <math id="alg1.l4.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="D" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>D</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">D</annotation></semantics></math> according to scores;

</div>
<div id="alg1.l5" class="ltx_listingline">
            <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline">5:</span>
            
            
             Generate answer: <math id="alg1.l5.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\hat{a}=\mathcal{G}_{\phi}(q,D)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>a</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒢</mi><mi>ϕ</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>q</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>D</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\hat{a}=\mathcal{G}_{\phi}(q,D)</annotation></semantics></math>

</div>
<div id="alg1.l6" class="ltx_listingline">
            <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline">6:</span>
            
            
             Compute reward: <math id="alg1.l6.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathrm{R}(a^{\ast},\hat{a})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>R</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>a</mi><mo>∗</mo></msup><mo>,</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>a</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathrm{R}(a^{\ast},\hat{a})</annotation></semantics></math>;

</div>
<div id="alg1.l7" class="ltx_listingline">
            <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline">7:</span>
            
            
             Estimate the expected task success for <math id="alg1.l7.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="d_{i}\in D" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>d</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>∈</mo><mi>D</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">d_{i}\in D</annotation></semantics></math>;

</div>
<div id="alg1.l8" class="ltx_listingline">
            <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline">8:</span>
            
            
             Sample a stochastic preference label;

</div>
<div id="alg1.l9" class="ltx_listingline">
            <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline">9:</span>
            
            
             Update reranker according to <math id="alg1.l9.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{L}_{\text{rank}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mtext>rank</mtext></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{L}_{\text{rank}}</annotation></semantics></math>;

</div>
<div id="alg1.l10" class="ltx_listingline">
            <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline">10:</span>
            
            
             Update generator according to <math id="alg1.l10.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{L}_{\text{gen}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mtext>gen</mtext></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{L}_{\text{gen}}</annotation></semantics></math>;

</div>
<div id="alg1.l11" class="ltx_listingline">
            <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline">11:</span>
            
            
            <span id="alg1.l11.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">end</span> <span id="alg1.l11.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">for</span>
</div>
<div id="alg1.l12" class="ltx_listingline">
            <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_listingline">12:</span>
            
            
           <span id="alg1.l12.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">end</span> <span id="alg1.l12.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">for</span>
</div>
</div>
</figure>
</section>

<td id="A2.T6.2.1.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_align_top ltx_border_tt">
<span id="A2.T6.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_align_top" style="width:199.2pt;">
<span id="A2.T6.2.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.T6.2.1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Prompt</span>: You are an expert evaluator for large model responses. Your core task is
to determine whether the large model’s response points to any of the correct answers.</span>
<span id="A2.T6.2.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_p">Please conduct the evaluation based on the following information:</span>
<span id="A2.T6.2.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_p">1. Question: {question}</span>
<span id="A2.T6.2.1.1.1.4" class="ltx_p">2. List of correct answers: {answers}</span>
<span id="A2.T6.2.1.1.1.5" class="ltx_p">3. Large model’s response: {response}</span>
<span id="A2.T6.2.1.1.1.6" class="ltx_p">Evaluation Rules:</span>
<span id="A2.T6.2.1.1.1.7" class="ltx_p">1. If the core information and key content of the large model’s response point to any
answer in the correct answer list (semantic consistency is acceptable, no need for
word-for-word matching), please output "yes".</span>
<span id="A2.T6.2.1.1.1.8" class="ltx_p">2. If the large model’s response deviates from all correct answers, contains obvious
errors, or fails to effectively respond to the question, please output "no".</span>
<span id="A2.T6.2.1.1.1.9" class="ltx_p">3. You only need to output a single word: either "yes" or "no", without any additional
redundant content.</span>
</span></td></tr>
<tr id="A2.T6.2.2" class="ltx_tr">
<td id="A2.T6.2.2.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_align_top ltx_border_bb ltx_border_t">
<span id="A2.T6.2.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_align_top" style="width:199.2pt;">
<span id="A2.T6.2.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.T6.2.2.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Output</span>: yes</span>
</span></td></tr>
</table>
</figure>
<figure id="A2.T7" class="ltx_table">
<figcaption class="ltx_caption"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_table">Table 7: </span>
Prompt of Inference
</figcaption>
<table id="A2.T7.2" class="ltx_tabular ltx_centering ltx_align_middle">
<tr id="A2.T7.2.1" class="ltx_tr">
<td id="A2.T7.2.1.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_align_top ltx_border_bb ltx_border_tt" style="padding-top:1pt;padding-bottom:1pt;">
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_align_top" style="width:384.1pt;">
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Prompt</span>: You are tasked with answering the given question by analyzing a set of documents.
Please follow this STRICT TWO-STEP PROCESS:</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_p">—</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_p">### STEP 1: Document Analysis</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.4" class="ltx_p">For each document:</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.5" class="ltx_p">- First, extract potentially relevant information from the original document. This includes facts, names, dates, or statements that may relate to the question, even if the connection is not immediately obvious.</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.6" class="ltx_p">- Then, explain the reason for the information extraction in your previous step based on the question. (e.g., how the document addresses the question’s focus).</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.7" class="ltx_p">### STEP 2: Final Answer</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.8" class="ltx_p">- Summarize your answer to the question based on the analysis above.
- If none of the documents are helpful or relevant, answer based on your own general knowledge. In that case, clearly state that you are doing so.</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.9" class="ltx_p">—</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.10" class="ltx_p">Use the following format for your response:</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.11" class="ltx_p">### Step 1: Document Analysis</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.12" class="ltx_p">Document 1:
- Extraction: …
- Explanation: …</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.13" class="ltx_p">Document 2:
- Extraction: …
- Explanation: …</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.14" class="ltx_p">### Step 2: Final Answer</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.15" class="ltx_p">Well-supported answer, based on the relevant documents. If no relevant documents, answer based on general knowledge and say so explicitly.</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.16" class="ltx_p">—</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.17" class="ltx_p">EXAMPLE:
Question: Who is the author of The Mahdi?</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.18" class="ltx_p">### Step 1: Document Analysis</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.19" class="ltx_p">Document 1:
- Extraction: ’Mahdi’ is a thriller novel by Philip Nicholson written in 1981 under the identity of a. J. Quinnell …
- Explanation: This document directly states that the author of ’Mahdi’ is Philip Nicholson. Upon re-examining the question "Who is the author of The Mahdi?", the document mentions the corresponding book title and provides the author information requested.</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.20" class="ltx_p">Document 2:
- Extraction: ’The Mahdi’ was published by Philip Nicholson in 1981
under the pen name A.J. Quinnell, establishing his presence in the thriller
genre with a novel known for its gripping plot and enduring popularity…
- Explanation: This document directly states that ’The Mahdi’ was
published by Philip Nicholson. Upon re-examining the question "Who
is the author of The Mahdi?", the document mentions the corresponding
book title and provides the author information requested.</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.21" class="ltx_p">### Step 2: Final Answer</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.22" class="ltx_p">Based on Documents 1 and 2, The answer to question ’Who is the author
of The Mahdi?’ is A.J. Quinnell, a pseudonym of Philip Nicholson.</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.23" class="ltx_p">—</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.24" class="ltx_p">Now it is your turn to analyze the following documents and answer the
given question by following the two-step process.</span>
<span id="A2.T7.2.1.1.1.25" class="ltx_p">{context} {question}</span>
</span></td></tr>
</table>
</figure>
</section>
</article>
